theorems.name: Submission.p04_prism_a8325b9888_boundary_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ {k X : Type _} [CommRing k] (u v : X → X), let P : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin (n + 1) → X) → MonoidAlgebra k (Fin (n + 2) → X) := fun n c => ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), MonoidAlgebra.single (Fin.insertNth j.castSucc (u (c j)) (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => if i < j then u (c i) else v (c i))) ((-1 : k) ^ j.val); (∀ c : Fin 1 → X, Rep.standardComplex.d k X 1 (P 0 c) = MonoidAlgebra.single (v ∘ c) (1 : k) - MonoidAlgebra.single (u ∘ c) (1 : k)) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 2) → X), Rep.standardComplex.d k X (n + 2) (P (n + 1) c) + ∑ b : Fin (n + 2), ((-1 : k) ^ b.val) • P n (c ∘ b.succAbove) = MonoidAlgebra.single (v ∘ c) (1 : k) - MonoidAlgebra.single (u ∘ c) (1 : k)
theorems.natural_summary: Expands the alternating differential and combines the accepted noncentral cancellation and central telescoping lemmas; in degree zero, the noncentral sum is empty.
